sentiment: Meaning is not placed into things; it assembles itself — symbol by symbol — from the quiet work of many small parts.
scene: An autumn study at dusk: warm lamplight on a wooden desk, and loose paper pages lifting into the air to arrange themselves into slow-turning constellations overhead, scattered golden symbols floating between them.

stories.title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
stories.reason: Fable and myth — the oldest vessels of meaning, now names worn by machines that assemble symbols into stories.
stories.summary: Anthropic's newest models borrow the oldest names for storytelling — a reminder that meaning was always assembled, never delivered whole.

stories.title: The Emergent Symbolic Structure of Artificial Neural Networks
stories.reason: Symbols waking unplanned inside a network — meaning rising from many small parts with no one placing it there.
stories.summary: A paper tracing how recognizably symbolic structure emerges from plain weights — structure as an emergent property, not an inscription.

stories.title: Fine, I'll build my own text editor
stories.reason: Hand-building the tool that holds words — craft as a quiet, concrete act of making meaning yourself.
stories.summary: One developer, one text editor, built by hand — the patient labor of assembling the instrument before the sentence.
